title: Earth / Water / Fire / Wind
purpose: Single reader-progress contract for spoiler-safe visibility across characters, locations, events, movements, relationships and historical micro-wiki triggers.
source_rule: Narrative progression and spoiler boundaries are derived only from the repository's verified chapter-level source corpus.

visibility_rules.character_state: Visible when the character has a state at or before current_section.
visibility_rules.location_state: Visible when the location is referenced by a visible character, event or transition at or before current_section.
visibility_rules.movement: Visible only when the transition is introduced by current_section; intended destinations remain intentions until a confirmed arrival exists.
visibility_rules.micro_wiki: Visible only when novel_trigger.first_section (or the legacy Book I first_book1_section) <= current_section and spoiler_safe_until <= current_section.
visibility_rules.future_information: Never expose entities, routes, identities or relationships whose first narrative appearance is after current_section.

identity_rule: Canonical character IDs remain stable while reader-facing display names may change at an explicit identity checkpoint.
topology_rule: Reader progress controls visibility; it does not alter the underlying geographic data or historical identification confidence.

section_policy.advance: Move forward only through existing project-local sections.
section_policy.rewind: Rewinding hides later information without deleting the stored reader position history in the application layer.
section_policy.chapter_mapping: Luni chapter mapping is intentionally absent until the user's edition index is available.
